# Jamie Oliver

> > The official home of British chef Jamie Oliver, featuring recipes, cooking guides, nutrition advice, and the Big Love Collection of sustainable serveware.

Jamie Oliver's platform offers thousands of recipes from quick 10-minute meals to festive party food, alongside cooking inspiration from TV shows like Friday Night Feast and Jamie Cooks Christmas. The site also features the Jamie Oliver Cookery School, nutritional guidance, and sustainable kitchenware from the Big Love Collection, with products available at retailers like Sainsbury's and Walmart Canada.

## Key Topics

- Jamie Oliver
- British cuisine
- Quick meals and 10-minute recipes
- Party recipes and entertaining
- Friday Night Feast TV show
- Jamie Oliver Cookery School
- Cooking guides and recipe inspiration
- Big Love Collection serveware
- Sustainable eating
- Comfort food and weeknight dinners
- Festive and Christmas recipes
- Sauces and condiments (Marie Rose, Nam Jim)
- Health and nutrition guides
- Spanish-style cuisine
- Sainsbury's partnerships

## Quick & Easy Recipes

- [Tasty 10-minute recipes to get food on the table, fast](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/best-10-minute-meals): 10-minute quick meal recipes with grain bowls & pasta by Jamie Oliver
- [Hassle-free healthy dinner ideas](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/hassle-free-healthy-dinners): Quick healthy dinner recipes using Jamie's Flavour Pastes
- [Easy midweek roast recipes](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/easy-midweek-roast-recipes): Quick midweek roast recipes for weeknight dinners by Jamie Oliver

## Cooking Guides & Inspiration

- [Guides to sauces & condiments](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/sauces-condiments): Homemade sauces, condiments, gravy & dressings guides by Jamie Oliver
- [Pie & pastry cooking guides & inspiration](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/pies-pastries): Pie and pastry cooking guides with sweet & savory British recipes
- [Cheese ideas & inspiration](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/cheese): Cheese recipes, cheeseboard guides & Westcombe Cheddar pairings
- [Spanish-style recipe inspiration](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/spanish-style): Spanish cuisine guides with tapas, chorizo & tortilla recipes
- [The 5 ingredients Jamie Oliver made famous](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/the-5-ingredients-jamie-oliver-made-famous): Jamie Oliver's 5 famous ingredients from The Naked Chef era

## Health & Nutrition

- [Health & nutrition guides](https://www.jamieoliver.com/nutrition//snacks): Expert nutrition guides on gut health, superfoods & balanced diet

## Festive & Party Recipes

- [Jamie Cooks Christmas | Recipes from the Channel 4 TV show](https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/christmas/jamie-cooks-christmas): Jamie Cooks Christmas Channel 4 TV show recipes collection
- [Christmas party food](https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/christmas/christmas-party-food): Christmas party food recipes with nibbles, dips & festive cocktails
- [New Year's Eve party recipes | Jamie Oliver recipes](https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/occasion/new-years-eve-party): New Year's Eve party recipes with cocktails, canapés & vegan treats

## TV Shows & Featured Content

- [Friday Night Feast](https://www.jamieoliver.com/inspiration/friday-night-feast): Jamie Oliver & Jimmy's Friday Night Feast TV show recipes and inspiration
- [Nostalgic 90s recipes](https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/90s): Nostalgic 90s recipes including Jamie's classic chicken in a bag
